prompt: Two feuding families on either side of the river, each with their own manor, farms and guards.

card.name: The Feuding Banks

site.text: A river running through the middle, with a family estate on each bank, facing one another across the water

style.text: Rustic manor-country look, with each family distinguished by its own colours and banners

purpose.text: Two rival family estates, each with a manor, farms and guards, kept apart by the river

story.text: Two families feud across the river.

card.interpretation: Site is a river with a family estate on each bank, using existing land. Style is rustic manor country, with each family given its own colours. Purpose is a farming settlement with two rival halves, each having a manor, farms and guards. Story is the feud, kept as given. Medium density.

contradictions.issue: Two hostile households in one settlement
contradictions.resolution: Mirrored halves on each bank, with guard towers facing the water and no shared market or tavern.

assumptions: Size M, flat-ish land found near a river.
Rustic style chosen as the fit for manors and farms.
No bridge assumed, as the families are feuding.
Roughly 15 buildings spread evenly across both banks.

program.notes: Seat of the first family, in its own colours, windows and balcony facing the river and the rival manor.
Seat of the second family, in contrasting colours, facing the first manor across the water.
One per bank, with a farmer's home by the fields.
One per bank, with fields and animal pens behind each manor.
One per bank, watching the river and the crossing.
Two per bank, homes of servants and farmhands.
One per bank, near the manor, with beds and armour racks.
